# Recorded resume assistant turns

These synthetic Web recordings use the configured DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model through `deepseek-account` / `deepseek-flash`, reasoning effort `high`, on 2026-11-01. No credentials or private reasoning are included. Each directory records its decoded source SHA-256 in `expected.json`.

| Scenario | Actual selected turn | Seed → saved revision | Calls and result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plugin-entry` | Plugin-created Session, turn 1 | 2 → 3 | Resolve its editor-entry binding, read, reject the malformed `op` discriminators, accept the corrected `type` operations, export JSON, read back |
| `ordinary-entry` | Existing ordinary Session, turn 10 | 35 → 36 | Resolve its existing explicit selection, read, edit, export JSON, read back; five calls without errors |
| `proposal-model-undo` | Plugin Session, turn 3 | 7 → 8 | Resolve, read, revert the exact seeded proposal, read back; preserve the later manual image-width change to 85 |

These are three separately seeded scenarios, not one uninterrupted replay of the browser history. Earlier manual operations and failed ordinary turns are excluded. The ordinary case starts with its actual existing binding; ordinary unbound selection is exercised by the separate scripted installation scenario. The undo seed includes the actual applied proposal identity and later manual edit, so no guessed proposal identity or replacement tool call is required.

`session.v4.jsonl` retains only the selected turn's start/end, step start/end, assistant tool/text streams and tool calls/results. Reasoning blocks, usage/account metadata, delivery markers, runtime/user-context inputs and system prompts are omitted. The selected turn is renumbered to 1. Tool arguments, tool-call chunk grouping and errors are retained. Final prose is reduced to the actual completion sentinel; exact host-specific export paths become `{{artifact}}/<filename>`. This is curated recorded-stream replay, not an untouched full-log snapshot. The original read-only image fixture remains independent and unchanged.

`prefix.jsonl` contains the actual four-event Session initialization, with only its working directory replaced by `{{cwd}}`. `resume.json`, `context.json` and `committed.json` retain the synthetic persisted input and output. The verifier asserts that the original header declares the Web `standard` preset, then omits only `agentPreset` from the temporary headless initialization copy and materializes its working directory. The public headless runner intentionally refuses preset-bearing Web Sessions. This approved projection checks installed tool behavior through supported `dsh --profile headless --session-id`; it does not establish same-Preset or full Web Session continuation. Original Web creation metadata remains in both fixture logs. Session identity, context records, documents and calls stay unchanged; the recorded bound resolve is never replaced with select. Actual Web Standard-Preset behavior is verified separately in browser acceptance.

The recorded mode derives responses from the curated streams through the public `llm-replay` reader. The separate scripted mode builds deterministic responses from the same tool arguments. Both assert the exact eleven-tool catalog, every persisted call/argument, expected rejection, full saved document, monotonic revision, prior history/receipts, exact request and changed-element receipt, Session binding, JSON bytes/content and final response. New proposal/export identities and save timestamps are validated and correlated with their actual durable records; original seeded identities and document contents are not normalized away. Headless tests cannot establish rendered view acknowledgements, PDF/PNG rendering or browser navigation; those require the controller's real Web acceptance.

Run the README's installed acceptance commands from the plugin root. The verifier deletes isolated profiles after awaited child completion unless `DSH_TEST_KEEP=1` explicitly retains evidence.
